authority.transport_dependency: Register ../../transport/v1/transport.schema.json as urn:ysp:transport:v1 before contract.schema.json. Shared Id, Version, UnitQuantity, UtcInstant, RecordReference, RecordState, CommandContext, OperationId and ActionResult are referenced, never duplicated.
authority.scope: Internal provider/consumer payloads only; no public generic registry, approval, stock or evidence-posting route. Existing operation-lookup OpenAPI remains the HTTP transport entry point. P02-P04 choose their minimal real routes when implemented; ticket 02 defines IPC/RM acceptance payload and transaction detail.
authority.schema_limit: JSON Schema proves shape and exact wire types, not current access, existence, cross-value equality, required source approval coverage, file availability, true signatures, content hashing or transactional safety. The server MUST enforce every relationship and consumer check below; authored fixtures are expected outcomes, not executed authorization/upload/posting tests. cases.json pairs concrete typed attempts with expected server-state fixtures and required outcomes; it does not execute a fake authorizer or uploader.

providers.version_ownership: Global user auth_version; membership authority_version; chapter authority/block/readiness guards; effective duty grants and policy-version roots.
providers.checks: Secure HTTPS HttpOnly session plus CSRF for mutations; shared MySQL session store; MFA for approvers/admins; current active user and chapter membership, effective scoped grants, approved alternates and actual immutable user independence. Revoke sessions on disable and recheck jobs/exports/downloads/delivery. Recovery never grants chapter authority. Client selection is a request, not a grant; provider/provisioner/billing/recovery status alone cannot read or sign chapter operations. Missing independent coverage blocks only the affected decision; no automatic self-approval.

providers.module: Documents and reporting shared record/operation boundary
providers.owner: Leader backend; Glenn reusable history/version UI
providers.version_ownership: Server assigns stable chapter/kind/record/line IDs, row_version, immutable material_version/hash, review requirements/decisions, sequence reservations, durable operation identity/result and append-only events.
providers.checks: Domain owns complete content and source links; registry drafts cannot authorize commitment. Saving an incomplete draft advances row concurrency. Submission creates a complete immutable material snapshot and requirements under approved policy. Return/rejection retains reason and history. Revision/resubmission creates a new material version and invalidates affected prior approvals; decisions are not copied. Issued documents change only through linked adjustments, never overwritten. Historical actor/duty/chapter snapshots survive disable/leave.

providers.owner: Leader backend; Glenn capture UI; Efren reviews backend integration
providers.version_ownership: Immutable stored object ID, content hash and opaque storage version; authorized append-only record binding; canonical recipient/batch acknowledgment snapshot hash.
providers.checks: Stage privately, validate actual nonempty bytes/type/content/configured size and safe handling, compute server SHA-256, then publish ready or reject to quarantined. No hard-coded illustrative upload limit is approved policy. Canvas exports PNG with smoothing/Clear/Redo, optional structured strokes supplementary; paper scan/photo uses validated image/PDF. Recheck scoped access before short-lived private download with no public caching. Current readiness and retrieval of the exact pinned bytes are required when consumed.

relationships: Every nested chapter equals the authorized operation chapter. Resolve user/membership/grant tuples server-side; same individual with provisioner and separate approved chapter grants operates only through the chapter grant.

MaterialReference.record must match RecordState.reference and material.record; material_version must match current authorized source content and its material_hash. Typed current content must hash to the approved snapshot, not a modified projection.
LineReference belongs to the exact chapter/record/kind, stable line and variant; array position or matching quantity is insufficient. Preserve retired lines and prior snapshots.

PolicyReference belongs to the same chapter and an authorized CONFIG approval; verify approved operational or financial duties as applicable, effective interval and settings_hash. Missing/unapproved/expired setup blocks its action with POLICY_NOT_EFFECTIVE while authorized drafts/corrections remain possible.

ReviewDecision target/policy/actor chapter and required step agree. Evaluate actual user identities under the record-specific rule set, not role count. RF, purchasing, ADJ variance and booth independence rules remain governing; there is no blanket preparer/poster inequality.

Ready evidence reference must resolve to the same chapter, evidence ID, hash and object version in the validated object row; duplicated ID with different hash/version fails EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH. No mutable latest-key substitution.

Binding target and optional line match the authorized business record. intended_record must match, or the source policy must explicitly authorize the different binding; staging owner alone is insufficient. Never accept arbitrary evidence-object possession as authorization. Binding is append-only and preserves operation/actor/time.

The schema's binding target carries material version/hash to the consumer; existing evidence_bindings storage has record/optional line and bound hash/version. This contract does not invent an already implemented material-version FK. P03 immutable material/event snapshots plus the owning typed source relationship must retain this version association; ticket 02 specifies concrete IPC/RM linkage before migrations/enablement.

Recipient acknowledgment binding record/chapter/material equals its exact batch snapshot. Resolve line/variant ownership, unique line IDs, positive actual quantities, current remaining entitlement and recipient facts; match capture method to validated object capture_mode. File hash and acknowledged_snapshot_hash remain distinct.
versions_and_history: Draft before first submission has material_version null. Shared RecordState requires a material version and is used only after a material snapshot exists. Returned incomplete edits remain in draft_payloads alongside the last submitted version, never rewritten over it.

EvidenceCheckInput requires expected_row_version and expected_material_version for an existing source. Adapter derives chapter/action from the authorized route and key from Idempotency-Key; client flags or a cached CurrentContext cannot supply authority.

Partial execution without changed approved content advances row/progress concurrency and retains material version and applicable approval. Actual partial receipt/handover remains with its domain consumer; no partial IPC baseline policy is introduced here.

Changed approved quantity, purpose, source, supplier, price or terms publishes a new immutable material snapshot, advances row version and invalidates affected prior approval. Stale material requires review and affected fresh evidence; old results remain history. Never silently substitute current versions into a preserved draft.

Record reference numbers are chapter/document-context unique, separate from IDs. Issue numbers serialized with issued records; preserve void/gap reasons and external supplier/customer document distinction. Print/regeneration/external copies do not create another number, payment, stock effect or source acceptance. Templates and issued data snapshots remain immutable; full output routes belong to P24.

lifecycle.immutability: Once ready, object hash/version/key do not change; replacement is a new evidence object and authorized binding, retaining superseded evidence. Availability may later become missing/archived without changing the original byte identity.
lifecycle.transaction: Object storage and MySQL are not one atomic transaction. Complete private upload and validation first. Bind/recheck ready evidence in the owning database operation with same transaction participation; do not perform a second participant commit. Reconcile missing objects; block current business commitment on unavailable/unready evidence. Keep history, record recovery/follow-up and never fabricate bytes or silently swap a file.
lifecycle.retention: Approved policy governs unattached staging cleanup and archival. Do not delete posted evidence/audit/history to fix records; preserve links and authorized review after officer departure. Storage/recovery policy approval and actual off-host storage are future implementation/readiness evidence.

canonical_hashes.encoding: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with no BOM, whitespace or final newline. Fixed key order below, explicit nulls, no omitted fields. Strings use JSON string escaping, preserve Unicode code points (no normalization); finite JSON integers only for material/version/scale; IDs and exact decimals remain strings. This is the bounded ysp-opening-v1 / ysp-batch-v1 serializer contract, not a generic JSON hashing algorithm.
canonical_hashes.opening_order: OpeningMaterial keys: chapter_id,record,counted_at,purpose,policy_version_id,counters,lines. Record keys: id,kind. Counters sorted by numeric user_id (length then lexical), keys user_id,is_regular_custodian. Lines sorted by numeric reference.line_id, keys reference,location_id,custody_assignment_id,condition_code,counted_quantity,unit_valuation,valuation_basis,restriction_version_id. LineReference keys: chapter_id,record,line_id,line_kind,variant_id. counted_quantity keys value,quantity_scale; value and unit_valuation normalized to six decimal places. No duplicate counter or line IDs. Governing complete snapshot extensions need a new explicit serializer revision; never silently omit required approved content.
canonical_hashes.batch_order: BatchSnapshot keys: chapter_id,record,material_version,batch_id,recipient,lines. Record keys id,kind. Recipient keys name,user_id,capacity. Lines sorted by numeric line.line_id, keys line,quantity; LineReference keys chapter_id,record,line_id,line_kind,variant_id. Quantities are positive exact strings at six places. No duplicate line IDs. row_version is excluded because concurrency is not acknowledged content.
canonical_hashes.identity: A byte hash never proves who signed. The authenticated capturing officer and immutable confirmed recipient facts remain attributable; business snapshot hash is not the signature image hash. Required actual signer and approval checks remain source-owned.
canonical_hashes.change_rule: Changed recipient, actual quantity/line/variant, material version or batch ID requires new matching acknowledgment and new evidence binding; retained old evidence is never rebound as if freshly signed. Other partial progress with unchanged material/batch preserves the content pin but still requires current row checks.

walkthrough.instruction: Load synthetic individually authenticated Receiving authority for chapter A and approved-for-test setup reference. Provider role possession does not authorize the operation. Live policy approval remains pending.

Save an incomplete IPC draft, then publish complete material 1 with stable line 501 for ten usable units. Review references retain Head/Finance duties and two counter identities including one independent of regular custody. Return/revise is an alternative branch and preserves material 1 history; material 2 needs affected reapproval.

Illustrate a signed count-sheet PDF progressing through stored-byte validation; rejection and later missing are alternative branches. This single sheet may carry both counter and Head/Finance signatures, but provider/consumer must inspect and verify actual required signers; shape does not establish signatures.

Authorize the binding, compare source row 7/material 1 and all evidence identity fields, retain immutable binding/result/audit under one operation. Binding advances source concurrency to row 8 while material remains 1. This count sheet is evidence ready for later review, not an IPC/RM acceptance or live opening baseline.

Use the rejection/uncertainty matrix before any business commitment. Preserve draft and original attempt; scoped original action+key or known operation ID lookup handles lost response. No terminal result is not proof of failure. Never repeat physical activity from a database retry.

Supplementary later IS/AR/customer DR example shows both signature methods on exact two-unit batch 602 for the named recipient. Changed batch requires fresh evidence. This is not a new recipient signature requirement for IPC or booth immediate sale.

failure_contract.condition: Wrong chapter, revoked/disabled membership, missing duty, provider-only status, unauthorized parent or failed MFA
failure_contract.check: Authorize before metadata disclosure. Redact chapter/record/operation/data, including on replay or download; never reveal whether the unauthorized record exists.

failure_contract.condition: Wrong parent/line/variant when both references are already authorized
failure_contract.check: Reject EVIDENCE_PARENT_MISMATCH before binding; if target is not visible use redacted forbidden instead.

failure_contract.condition: Expected row is 7, current row is 8 with material 1 unchanged
failure_contract.check: STALE_ROW_VERSION supplies only authorized current state; retain draft and compare current progress, no silent rebase.

failure_contract.condition: Expected material 1, current material 2 with affected old approval/evidence
failure_contract.check: STALE_MATERIAL_VERSION requires current review and fresh affected evidence; history remains.
EVIDENCE_NOT_READY blocks. Rejected outcome maps to quarantined, never ready.

failure_contract.condition: Exact stored object missing, archived or not retrievable
failure_contract.http_mapping: 409 blocked before known commitment; transport failure remains uncertain
failure_contract.check: EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE blocks before commitment. Availability failure discovered after uncertain/known commitment requires lookup/reconciliation; never claim rollback from an unavailable read.

failure_contract.condition: Object ID matches but pinned byte hash/storage version differs
failure_contract.check: EVIDENCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; do not silently upgrade immutable evidence identity.

failure_contract.condition: Required approved setup missing, unapproved or no longer effective
failure_contract.check: POLICY_NOT_EFFECTIVE; explicit missing-policy feedback, draft preparation/correction under current authority remains possible.

failure_contract.condition: Acknowledged recipient, material or actual batch changes
failure_contract.check: ACKNOWLEDGMENT_MISMATCH; retain prior evidence as history, require fresh matching capture and binding before handover posting.

failure_contract.condition: Response lost or operation lookup unavailable
failure_contract.check: Original chapter/action/key identity is preserved; no visible terminal result is not a negative acknowledgment. No new key/payload or repeated physical handover bypasses uncertainty.

later_consumers.owner: Purchasing/Receiving outer application operation (Leader), Inventory posting participant (Efren), Documents evidence participant (Leader); Glenn source/query consumer
later_consumers.must_check: Current Access authority/MFA/approved source policy and versions, genuine complete IPC with counter independence and required counter/Head/Finance signatures, inspected RM valid source/parent/line/variant, every required ready evidence pin and actual availability, remaining quantities/condition/valuation/restrictions and opening once-only fence. P03 result, audit and durable follow-up and Inventory posting join one outer intended-MySQL transaction without independent participant commits. Ticket 02 defines exact acceptance input, locks, relationships and migrations. No IPC/RM acceptance is certified here.

later_consumers.ticket_package: Later IS/AR and customer DR / P11-P15
later_consumers.owner: Owning handover operations; Glenn UI; Efren posting/Finance participants
later_consumers.must_check: Exact positive actual batch/recipient/material against acknowledged_snapshot_hash and ready immutable file, current row/material/authority/independence and domain stock/payment/release coverage. Both Canvas and paper capture supported; changed batch needs fresh acknowledgment. This contract chooses no later financial route or refund workflow.

validation.targeted_development: From contracts/transport use node --test --test-name-pattern=<slice> tests/identity-record-evidence.test.mjs; final test command runs both contract files once after all slices are green.
validation.executed_scope: Strict Ajv 2020-12 shape/example checks plus fixture relationship, canonical snapshot, lifecycle and preserved outcome checks. Recorded executed results live in the local 08 handoff; schema example evidence_state stays expected.
not_evidence_of: Live policy approval or actual independent officer review
Actual uploads, byte validation, object retrieval or human signatures
Glenn/Efren acceptance, P00 completion, P01 reproduction/CI, P02-P04 runtime or P06 opening acceptance

compatibility: Existing Inventory, Sales, Delivery and Requisition proposals remain proposals and retain their unique information. Consumer adapters must map their record/material fields and action-aware lookup to ticket 01, and their file hash/object version/recipient snapshot fields to this contract. No proposal is silently promoted or rewritten; actual consumer compatibility and real peer acceptance remain pending.
